name: script-memory
description: Turn a theatre script, dialogue, or speech draft in any common file format into a single-file offline memorisation trainer, and normalise the script document first without altering one word of dialogue.
author: yzh5310

targetAudience.direct: AI agents that normalise a script and generate a rehearsal tool
targetAudience.ultimate: Performers, students and presenters memorising lines, a monologue or a speech

productPromise: Produce a normalised script whose dialogue is provably unchanged, plus one offline page that enforces a fixed memorisation order: skeleton, anchors, reusable parts, physical cue sheet.

outputs.document: Normalised script document (docx or markdown) with unified scaffolding
outputs.application: Single self-contained offline HTML rehearsal page

cueCodes.L: spoken line (must stay byte-identical to the source)

memorySequence: physical cue sheet (leading 3 words per line)

privacy.localState: localStorage key derived from the title (CFG.stateKey)
